name: 53949 · Montello, WI
findings: ZIP 53949 (Montello) has 8 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 3 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53949 (Montello) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
